title: Machine Learning Revealed Ferroptosis Features and a Novel Ferroptosis-Based Classification for Diagnosis in Acute Myocardial Infarction
summary: The study reports candidate molecular associations and a classification signature from transcriptomic data. The result is an exploratory candidate signature and does not establish causal biology or clinical diagnostic utility.
ai_technology: Machine-learning analysis of acute-myocardial-infarction transcriptomes identifies ferroptosis-related biomarkers and a diagnostic signature.
